headline: Advantech Delivers Record Q3 Revenue Growth Despite Margin Pressure
summary: Industrial hardware maker Advantech achieved record quarterly sales growth in Q3 2026, though operating margins came under pressure.
why: Advantech is a global provider of industrial computers and IoT hardware solutions used across worldwide manufacturing and automated facilities.

impacts.name: Advantech
impacts.why: Advantech achieved record quarterly sales while experiencing pressure on profit margins.
